name: ListMetaCollections

parameters.help_en:
The collection type. Valid values:

Category: category.
Album: data album.
AlbumCategory: album subcategory
parameters.help_zh:
集合类型，可枚举，取值为

Category 类目
Album 数据专辑
AlbumCategory 专辑子类目
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent node collection object
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.help_en: The collection name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The collection description. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the creator. This parameter is valid only for the album type. Default value: the current user ID
parameters.help_zh: 创建者用户ID，专辑类型有效，默认为当前用户ID
parameters.name: create_user

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collection administrator. This parameter is valid only for the album type. Default value: the current user ID
parameters.help_zh: 集合管理员ID，专辑类型有效，默认为当前用户ID
parameters.name: administrator

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Valid values:

Id (default)
Name: name.
CreateUser: creator ID.
CreateTime: creation time.
ModifyTime: modification time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段, 支持

Id（默认）
Name 名称
CreateUser 创建者ID
CreateTime 创建时间
ModifyTime 修改时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Valid values:

Asc (default)
Desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向，支持

Asc（默认）
Desc
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
